description: Reads the signed-in user's account id, display name and sign-in email, plan, token balance, applications left, job preferences and readiness: whether a resume and target roles are on file. The answer names empty profile fields to add once. Changes nothing.
name: getmattered_get_account

email.description: The address the account signs in with.

id.description: The GetMattered user id. Stable: the same account always has the same id.

name.description: The display name on the account, when one is set.

account.description: Who this connection is signed in as. Name it to the user before acting when more than one GetMattered account is connected.

autopilot.description: Whether GetMattered applies on its own. Read only.

defaultApplyMode.description: What getmattered_apply does when mode is omitted. Read only.

connectUrl.description: Dashboard page where the user connects or reconnects these accounts. Connecting needs the provider's own sign-in in a browser.

connected.description: True when GetMattered can use this account now.

status.description: The recorded state, such as connected, needs_reconnect, signing_in, waiting_for_phone_code or failed. Null when it was never connected.

connected.description: True when GetMattered can use this account now.

status.description: The recorded state, such as connected, needs_reconnect, signing_in, waiting_for_phone_code or failed. Null when it was never connected.

connected.description: True when GetMattered can use this account now.

status.description: The recorded state, such as connected, needs_reconnect, signing_in, waiting_for_phone_code or failed. Null when it was never connected.

integrations.description: Which outside accounts are connected. Null when it could not be read.

askUserFor.description: The one thing to ask the user for next: resume or target_roles. Null when nothing is missing.

missingRequiredForApply.description: Profile fields employer forms can require that are empty. GetMattered fills address fields from the user's saved address and location. With gap filling on, it also fills an empty postal code. With gap filling off, a form that requires a postal code is not sent until the profile has one. An empty state or country never stops a form. The user adds each field once on the profile, not per application.

nextStep.description: The instruction for askUserFor, or the applications waiting for review, ready to follow. Null when nothing is open.

resumeOnFile.description: False means apply will fail: call getmattered_set_resume first.

id.description: Pass to getmattered_set_resume as document_id to make it the base resume.

setupStep.description: Set while account setup is open: the step to take first.

title: Get Account
